name: Interior painting
summary: Interior repaints priced from walls, ceilings, trim, doors and windows by production rate and coats.

items.label: Walls, 2 coats
items.source: 200 sq ft/h, 2nd coat at 0.65 -> 1.65/200 h; paint $45/gal at 350 sq ft/gal/coat, 2 coats, 10% waste (index.html defaults and default rows)

items.label: Ceilings, 2 coats
items.source: 175 sq ft/h x 1.65 coat factor; paint as walls (index.html defaults)

items.label: Trim / baseboard, 2 coats
items.source: 50 lf/h x 1.65; 0.5 sq ft paintable per lf (SURFACE_PRESETS in calc.mjs) x 2 coats x 1.1 / 350 x $45

items.label: Doors (both sides + jamb), 2 coats
items.source: 1.25 doors/h x 1.65; 40 sq ft per door (SURFACE_PRESETS) x 2 coats x 1.1 / 350 x $45

items.label: Windows / sashes, 1 coat
items.source: 2.5 windows/h, 1 coat; 12 sq ft per window (SURFACE_PRESETS) x 1.1 / 350 x $45

items.label: Prep: patch, sand, caulk, mask
items.source: Prep hours 6; tape, plastic, other $35 (index.html defaults)

items.label: Travel and mileage
items.source: travelCost $40 (index.html default); the specialist has no miles input

specialistModels: Ceiling-height slowdown on walls, extra-coat labor factor, per-surface paint coverage, and a check against a $/floor-sq-ft rule of thumb.
